validation_mad_rule.note: Review candidates only, not confirmed incorrect prices; no rows removed.

ask.target: Exact positive dollar bounds [price, price]; auction prices use CPI-reference dollars. SurvivalAft logs bounds internally. RawFormulaVal is log reference price; exp(raw) restores conditional median dollars, then CPI ratio restores auction date. No double logarithm. No invented censoring.
ask.evaluation: Original chronological train/validation/test. Validation selects stopping iteration and residual MAD/smearing; test remains unfiltered and unused for fitting or tuning. Native categorical handling, no one-hot. Both previous outlier audits are diagnostic only. No model deployment or full-cohort refit.
